# Imaging

The total imaging count is analyzed with the same adjusted Bayesian
negative-binomial rate model as tissue biopsy: randomized treatment, linear
age, ECOG 0/1/2/3+, and `log(observed_survival_days)` as offset.  Each imaging
examination is counted once by its event identifier.

Descriptive summaries are shown for CT, MRI, and PET-CT.  Missing or
unrecognized modalities are retained in an explicit `missing_or_unknown`
category and do not alter the total-count denominator.

```{r}
#| eval: false

source(here::here("analysis", "05-secondary", "secondary-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "count-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-validation.R"))

cohort <- read_pseudonymized_parquet(
  here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"),
  schema = here::here("data", "schema", "cohort_follow_up.yml")
)
imaging <- read_pseudonymized_parquet(
  here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-imaging.parquet"),
  schema = here::here("data", "schema", "imaging.yml")
)

imaging_data <- secondary_observed_follow_up(
  cohort, origin_col = "randomization_date", horizon_days = 182L,
  output_col = "observed_survival_days"
)
# Count only examinations observed between randomization and each participant's
# fixed-lock/182-day observed end.  Unknown modalities remain in the event
# table and are classified descriptively below.
imaging_lookup <- imaging_data[, c("id", "randomization_date", "observed_end_date"),
                               drop = FALSE]
imaging <- merge(imaging, imaging_lookup, by = "id", all = FALSE)
imaging <- imaging[imaging$imaging_date >= imaging$randomization_date &
                     imaging$imaging_date <= imaging$observed_end_date, , drop = FALSE]
unique_imaging <- imaging[!duplicated(imaging$imaging_id), , drop = FALSE]
imaging_counts <- as.data.frame(table(as.character(unique_imaging$id)),
                                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(imaging_counts) <- c("id", "imaging_count")
imaging_counts$imaging_count <- as.integer(imaging_counts$imaging_count)
imaging_data <- secondary_join_count(imaging_data, imaging_counts, "imaging_count")
imaging_data$ecog_3_plus <- secondary_collapse_ecog(imaging_data$ecog_fstcnt)
secondary_count_ready(imaging_data, "imaging_count", "observed_survival_days")

modality <- toupper(trimws(as.character(unique_imaging$modality)))
modality <- gsub("[ _]+", "-", modality)
modality[modality %in% c("PETCT", "PET/CT")] <- "PET-CT"
modality_group <- ifelse(
  is.na(modality) | modality == "", "missing_modality",
  ifelse(modality %in% c("CT", "MRI", "PET-CT"), modality, "other_or_unknown")
)
modality_summary <- as.data.frame(table(modality_group), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(modality_summary) <- c("modality", "n_examinations")
modality_summary$missing_or_unknown <- modality_summary$modality %in% c(
  "missing_modality", "other_or_unknown"
)

imaging_formula <- imaging_count ~ tx + age + ecog_3_plus +
  offset(log(observed_survival_days))
imaging_fit <- rstanarm::stan_glm(
  formula = imaging_formula,
  data = imaging_data,
  family = rstanarm::neg_binomial_2(),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  seed = 17006
)
write_atomic_parquet(
  modality_summary,
  project_path("results", "secondary", "imaging", "modality-summary.parquet")
)
```

Admissions and emergency-room visits have no standalone model here: they are
already represented by the TAOOH ordinal states (planned admission, ER,
unplanned admission, alive/out of hospital, and death).
